blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method. On Shot7M2, the synthetic basketball benchmark built by hBehaveMAE's authors, it scores 68.8 against 64.7 for hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, though hBehaveMAE remains better on the shortest movements. Short time windows carry most of the result. Raw keypoints in each body's own frame, summarized over the same windows, already match or beat the encoders on both mouse datasets and on Shot7M2; on the fly groups they fall short, and the measurements add 5.3 points. On these benchmarks, current behavior encoders have yet to beat the hand-built features they learn from, and such baselines should be reported alongside them.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的动物行为编码器经常在手建动作特征上接受训练或喂食. 我们问他们是否公平比较了这些成分。 在预先登记的协议下,与重新培训和释放的编码器(BAMS, hBEhaveMAE)相比,采用在固定时间窗口中汇总的、与五氯苯甲醚相比减少的通用每帧计量法制作的免费培训表述:同大小的冻结表述和一个共享的分类器。 在CalMS21上,它达到85.8宏F1对82.4对最佳编码器,与4个标注的视频连接,当注释器改变或新行为必须从几段视频中得知时,线索;对编码器的读取控制用3个种子重新训练. 在 MABE22 鼠标三进制中,它对于释放的 hBehaveMAE(gap +3.4,95%的间隔+2.1到+4.7)的比分为83.7比80.3. 在第二个物种上,MABE22的蝇类组,同样的食谱评分51.6比50任务中的F1比48.2,BAMS是最佳公布的方法. 在Shot7M2上,HBEhaveMAE的作者们构建的合成篮球基准对hBEhaveMAE的成绩为68.8比64.7,这是该论文中最好的方法,不过hBEhaveMAE在最短的移动上仍然较好. 时间短的窗口承载了大部分结果. 每个机体自身框架的原始键点,在同一个窗口上总结,已经在鼠标数据集和Shot7M2上匹配或击败编码器;在苍蝇组上它们落差,测量结果增加了5.3分. 在这些基准上,目前的行为编码器还没有比起他们从中学习的手建的特性,应该同时报告这种基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Machine learning for animal behavior has moved from hand-built features to representations learned without labels.
Recent self-supervised encoders such as BAMS [ 1 ] , hBehaveMAE [ 11 ] and
MICE [ 12 ] learn from tracked poses and report gains on the standard mouse benchmarks. Several of them are
trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features: BAMS learns to predict histograms of future movement features, and
its mouse recipe takes hand-built pose features as input.
blocks.zh:
动物行为的机器学习已经从手工建造的特征转移到没有标签就学到的表达.
最近的自我监督编码器,如BAMS [1]、hBehaveMAE [11]和
MICE [12] 从履带式姿势中学习,并报告在鼠标标准基准上的收益. 有几个是
训练或喂养手动运动特性: BAMS学习预测未来运动特征的直方图,以及
它的鼠标配方采用手工构建的特性作为输入.

blocks.en:
This raises a question the literature has not tested directly. Do these encoders beat the hand-built ingredients they
are built from, when both get the same classifier and the same budget of numbers per frame?
blocks.zh:
这就提出了文献没有直接检验的问题。 做这些编码器 击败手造的成分
当两者得到相同的分类器和每个框架的相同数字预算时,它们都是从?

blocks.en:
We answer it with a deliberately plain baseline. For each frame we compute a few dozen generic measurements of
position, speed, turning, body shape and the relation between animals. Each is summarized over fixed time windows from
half a second to the whole clip, and PCA reduces the result to the benchmark’s budget. Nothing is trained by gradient
descent, and no label is used to build the representation.

我们用一个刻意的简单基准来回答它。 我们每帧计算几十个通用测量
姿势,速度,转弯,身体形状以及动物之间的关系. 在每个固定的时间窗口中汇总
将结果降低到基准预算。 没有梯度训练
effect,且不使用标签来构建代表.

blocks.en:
We compare it with retrained and released self-supervised encoders under a frozen-representation protocol. Every
method gives the same number of values per frame, and the same small classifier is trained on top. To keep the
comparison honest we preregistered it: before any test score existed, each test’s design and the rule for reading it
were written down and hashed, and every later choice was made on training data only.
blocks.zh:

方法给出每个帧的数值相同,同样的小分类器在顶部被训练. 为了保持
比较诚实,我们预先注册了:在测试分数存在之前,每个测试的设计和阅读规则
被写下来并散开, 每一个后来的选择 仅对培训数据。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Several methods learn frame-level embeddings from tracked poses
without behavior labels and evaluate them with small classifiers on frozen features. TREBA [ 14 ] trains
trajectory embeddings with self-supervised tasks that domain experts write as programs (“task programming”).
BAMS [ 1 ] uses two temporal convolutional networks for short- and long-term dynamics, trained to
predict histograms of future actions and to stay consistent across time, and it ranked first on both MABe 2022
trajectory leaderboards. hBehaveMAE [ 11 ] learns a hierarchy of masked-autoencoder
representations from pose. MICE [ 12 ] is a hierarchical foundation model for mouse behavior pretrained on
six mouse datasets; on CalMS21 it reports 83.28 macro F1 with a probe on frozen features, and 84.56 with
multi-dataset pretraining. Unsupervised methods such as B-SOiD [ 4 ] , VAME [ 8 ] and
Keypoint-MoSeq [ 16 ] instead segment behavior into discrete motifs.
blocks.zh:
几种方法从履带式姿势中学习帧级嵌入
没有行为标签, 并用小分类器评价它们 关于冻结的特性。 TREBA [14] 列车
轨迹嵌入自控任务,域专家作为程序(“任务编程”)编写.
BAMS [1] 使用两个时间演化网络进行短期和长期动态学,经过培训,可
预测未来动作的直方图,并保持跨时间的一致性,在MABE 2022中都排名第一.
弹道导板 hhaveMAE [11] 学习一个层次的蒙面自动编码器
从姿势表达。 MICE [12] 是鼠标行为的分级基础模型 预训于
6个鼠标数据集;在CalMS21上,它报告83.28个宏F1,对冷冻特性进行探测,84.56与
多数据集预训. 无监督方法,如B-SOiD[4]、VAME[8]和
Keypoint-MoSeq [16] 转而将行为分解为离散动机.

blocks.en:
Supervised behavior classifiers have long used hand-built features of pose
and of the relations between animals. JAABA [ 5 ] turns a few labelled frames into classifiers for
flies, mice and larvae. MARS [ 10 ] classifies mouse social behavior with random forests on
hand-designed pose features, and SimBA [ 3 ] builds explainable classifiers from features such as
movement, posture and proximity. CalMS21’s poses come from MARS, and its Task 1 training and test videos match those
of MARS’s classifiers. In a study of visual context, Li et al. [6] found MARS’s hand-engineered
features ahead of BAMS and hBehaveMAE on CalMS21, and treated this as an exception owed to features engineered for
two-mouse recordings. Our representation follows this tradition, but its measurements are generic, it defines no
behavior, and it uses no labels.

nine datasets [ 17 ] . Random convolutional kernels with a linear classifier matched state-of-the-art

features summarize a series at a modest cost in accuracy (catch22 [ 7 ] ). In deep metric learning,
reported gains shrank to marginal ones under careful evaluation [ 9 ] . Our study does the same
for behavior representations, with the comparison preregistered.

blocks.en: 3 Method: a training-free representation
blocks.zh: 3个 方法:免费参加培训

blocks.en:
The representation has three steps: per-frame measurements, statistics of each measurement over fixed time windows,
and a linear reduction fitted without labels.
blocks.zh:
说明分为三个步骤:每帧计量、固定时间窗口内每项计量的统计、
和无标签的线性还原。

blocks.en:
For CalMS21 (two mice, seven keypoints each, 30 Hz) we use 23 measurements
(Table 1 ). Keypoints are first smoothed with a three-frame median filter. Distances are in body
lengths, the clip’s median nose-to-tail distance, and speeds in body lengths per second, so camera scale drops out. No
measurement uses the arena’s position or axes.
blocks.zh:
对于CalMS21(两只小鼠,每只7个键点,30赫兹),我们使用23个测量值.
(表1) (单位:千美元) 键位首先用三帧中位滤镜平滑. 距离在体内
长度,片段的中位鼻对尾距离,以及每秒身体长度的速度,所以相机尺度会下降. 没有
使用竞技场的位置或轴进行测量。

blocks.en: Table 1: The 23 CalMS21 measurements, in seven groups.
blocks.zh: 表1:23 CalMS21测量数据,分为七组.

blocks.en:
For each measurement we keep its value at the frame and, over centred windows of 0.5,
2, 8 and 30 seconds, its mean, its standard deviation and an 8-bin histogram. The bin edges are quantiles of that
measurement on training data.
blocks.zh:
对于每一项测量,我们保持其值在帧上,并且,在中心窗口0.5,
2,8和30秒,它的平均值,标准偏差和一个8位直方图. 宾馆边缘就是其中的四分之一
衡量培训数据。

blocks.en:
The statistics are standardized and reduced with PCA to the benchmark’s budget of numbers per
frame (128 on CalMS21 and the MABe22 mice). Moments and PCA are fitted on unlabelled and training videos without
labels, then frozen.
blocks.zh:
统计数据标准化,与常设仲裁法院相比,减少到基准预算的每人人数。
框架(CalMS21和MABE22小鼠128)。 运动器和五氯苯甲醚装在无标签的录像上,培训录像没有
标签,然后冻结。

blocks.en:
Four layouts were defined before any scoring: one PCA or two (short and long windows apart), each
with or without the histograms. The layout is chosen by cross-validation on training data only. CalMS21 chose two PCAs
with histograms: 64 numbers from the frame value and the two short windows, and 64 from the two long windows.
blocks.zh:
在任何评分之前定义了四个布局:一个或两个(短窗和长窗相隔),每个
不管有没有直方图 该布局仅通过对训练数据的交叉验证来选择. CalMS21选择了两个五氯苯甲醚
带有直方图:64位数字来自帧值和两个短窗,64位数字来自两个长窗.

blocks.en:
The same recipe uses 89 measurements written for three mice: per-mouse speeds, body
lengths, turning and position in the arena, plus pairwise distances, closing speeds, facing and approach. Per-mouse
and pairwise values are sorted across animals, so the representation does not depend on mouse order. The windows add
the whole 60-second clip, because the benchmark’s clip-level labels are defined per clip. Everything is fitted on the
1,600 user-train clips, and cross-validation there chose two PCAs without histograms in the short half.
blocks.zh:

长度,转弯和在竞技场的位置,加上双向距离,关闭速度,面对和接近. 每分钟
和对等值在动物之间排序,因此表示不依赖于鼠标顺序. 窗口添加

1600个用户列车剪辑,在那里交叉验证选择了两个没有直方图的PCA在短半部.

blocks.en:
For groups of up to 11 flies at 150 Hz we wrote 24 generic measurements per fly
(speeds, turning, body and wing posture, leg reach, and relations to the nearest fly), pooled over flies by mean,
spread, minimum and maximum, plus four group measurements: 100 numbers per frame. Windows run from 0.5 s to the whole
30 s clip, and PCA reduces to the benchmark’s limit of 256. Everything is fitted on the 426 user-train clips, and
cross-validation there chose one PCA of means and spreads.

(速度、转弯、身体和翅膀姿势、腿伸直度和与最近的苍蝇的关系)
分布,最小和最大,加上四组测量:每帧100个数字. 视窗从0.5s运行到整个

在那里,交叉验证选择了一种途径和分布。

blocks.en:
For one simulated 3D body (26 joints, 30 Hz) we wrote 40 measurements: body size; pelvis and
head height; for each wrist and ankle, its position in the body’s frame, its speed and its vertical speed; elbow and
knee angles and their rates; trunk lean and twist; signed turning speed; hand and foot gaps; and stillness. Left and
right limbs are kept apart. The windows are those of the MABe22 mice, PCA reduces to the benchmark’s 64 numbers, and
cross-validation on the 1,280 user-train episodes chose two PCAs of means and spreads.
blocks.zh:
对于一个模拟的3D体(26关节,30Hz),我们写了40个测量:体积;骨盆和
头部高度;每个手腕和踝关节,在机体构架中的位置,速度和垂直速度;肘和
膝盖角及其速率; 树干倾斜和曲折; 签名转速; 手脚间隙; 静态。 左边和
右肢被分开 窗户是MABE22小鼠的窗户,五氯苯甲醚将基准数减少到64,以及
在1,280个用户列车的节目上进行交叉验证,选择了两个PCPA的方法和分布.

blocks.en:
Each measurement set is a few dozen ordinary kinematic quantities computed from
the tracked points: positions, speeds, distances, angles and heights, of the kind found in any behavior-analysis
toolkit. None of them defines a behavior, and none uses a label. Each dataset’s per-frame measurement function is
under 100 lines of Python (46 for CalMS21, 82 for the MABe22 mice, 78 for the flies, 43 for Shot7M2). Fitting the
window statistics and PCA takes minutes on a CPU; training BAMS on CalMS21 alone took us 5 to 6 hours on a GPU.
Section 6 measures how much the measurements add over raw keypoints summarized the same way. All
runs used one workstation with an Intel Core i9-12900KF CPU (16 cores), 64 GB of RAM and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080
SUPER GPU (16 GB).

工具包。 没有人定义行为,也没有人使用标签. 每个数据集的每帧计量功能是:
Python下100行(46为CalMS21,82为MABE22小鼠,78为苍蝇,43为Shot7M2). 装配
窗口统计和PCA在CPU上需要几分钟时间;仅CalMS21上的BAMS培训在GPU上需要5到6小时.
第6节衡量了测量值在原始关键点上增加多少,并总结了同样的方式。 全体
运行使用一个工作站,配有Intel Core i9-12900KF CPU(16个核心),64GB RAM和NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080
超级GPU(16 GB).

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4 评价协议

blocks.en:
Every method gives the same number of values per frame, and the
encoders stay frozen. On CalMS21 the same classifier is trained on top of each method: a linear layer or a
one-hidden-layer MLP with 512 units, with or without class balancing, over a fixed grid of L2 penalties
(14 settings). Each method’s setting, and its own variant (for example which hBehaveMAE level), is chosen by
cross-validation on the 70 training videos only. Each method is then scored once on the 19 official test videos, as
macro F1 over attack, investigation and mount.

(14个设置). 每种方法的设置以及它自己的变体(例如hBehaveMAE级别)由下列人选择:

authors’ template and once fed our 23 measurements; the second scored higher on training videos and is the one
reported. hBehaveMAE is read at each of its three levels, and the best on training videos is used. On MABe22 we used
the authors’ released hBehaveMAE checkpoint and the benchmark’s own evaluator, which trains ridge classifiers with
three seeds and takes a majority vote. There we report clip-level F1 (mouse strain, lights on or off) and frame-level
F1. On the fly groups we used the MABe 2022 public evaluator and compare with BAMS’s published score. On Shot7M2 we used
the released hBehaveMAE checkpoint and the authors’ evaluator.

Before any test score existed, each test’s design and its reading rule were written down
and hashed, and the run scripts refuse to start if any file differs (Appendix A ). For CalMS21 Task 1
the rule reads: the claim holds if, at both label amounts, the features are at or above the best encoder, or the 95%
interval on their gap includes zero. Deviations were recorded with a timestamp before the scores they affect existed.
For example, the reproduction target for hBehaveMAE on MABe22 was corrected from the paper’s inductive score to its
transductive one, which is what the released model is; our run matches that score to the decimal.

With all labels the training-free features beat both encoders, and the better one,

Against the authors’ released hBehaveMAE, scored with the benchmark’s own
evaluator, the features lead by 3.4 points of clip-level F1; resampling the 1,068 test clips puts the paired interval
at + 2.1 +2.1 to + 4.7 +4.7 (Table 4 ). They are ahead on all 11 binary tasks: strain (92.9 against 87.1),
lights (74.4 against 73.4) and each of the nine frame-level behaviors. The released model
was pretrained on the test clips without labels, while our statistics were fitted on the training clips only. 83.7 is
also above every method in the hBehaveMAE paper’s table. We do not count the frame-level
tasks as evidence, because their labels were partly computed from the poses.

blocks.en:
On a second species, from a different laboratory, the recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over
the benchmark’s 50 fly tasks, against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method (Table 5 ). Resampling the 326 test clips gives our score a 95% interval of 48.4 to 53.3; the published 48.2 has no interval of its own, so this comparison is not paired. The rule was
locked before any fly score existed, and before any of our scores the benchmark’s public scorer reproduced its own
published scores for the sample submission. The score comes mostly from the clip-level tasks (Appendix C ; genotype 50.6 and line category
68.7, against 14.5 and 28.4 for the random sample submission). The per-fly behavior tasks stay below the random
submission (17.0 against 21.0), because the representation pools over flies. A layout that keeps the flies apart,
added after this result (16 numbers per fly plus 80 for the group), lifts the per-fly tasks to 24.8 and sex to 97.6
but lowers the group tasks, for 48.8 overall; so pooling explains the weak per-fly scores.

blocks.en:
On a simulated basketball player, the benchmark hBehaveMAE’s authors built to show what a
hierarchical encoder learns, the features lead hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, by 4.2 points of All F1
(paired interval over the 680 test episodes + 3.7 +3.7 to + 4.6 +4.6 ; Table 6 ). By the rule locked before any
basketball score existed, the features are at or above hBehaveMAE. Before our features were scored, the authors’
released model, run with their test settings and scored by their evaluator, reproduced its published All F1 and
per-scale bests. The lead comes from activities, the episode-level labels. Actions are about level, with hBehaveMAE
better on spins and turns and the features better on sprint. hBehaveMAE is ahead on movemes, the shortest scale: foot
and hand contacts, the ball, and elbow flexing and extending. So on the shortest movements the learned encoder earns
its keep. Because the generator defines movemes from the motion itself, the rule also reads the activity and action
scales without them: 73.9 against 65.6, the same reading.

手接头 球 肘伸展 因此,在最短的动作上, 学习的编码器挣得

blocks.en: 6 What carries the result
blocks.zh: 6个 结果是什么?

blocks.en:
To see which ingredients matter, a second preregistered test strips the representation down. It adds the measurement
groups back one at a time, scores each step on training videos, and picks the smallest step within one point of the
full set. The rule picked 19 measurements, everything except posture. On the test videos that version beats
hBehaveMAE with all labels ( + 2.6 +2.6 [ + 1.6 +1.6 , + 3.8 +3.8 ]) and ties BAMS with 5% ( − 1.4 -1.4 [ − 4.7 -4.7 , + 4.1 +4.1 ]). The full 23 are + 0.8 +0.8 [ + 0.2 +0.2 , + 1.5 +1.5 ] points better with all labels, so they remain the method. Against encoders retrained with two
further seeds, the 19-measurement version keeps its reading: ahead of both with all labels in all three passes (mean
gaps + 7.2 +7.2 over BAMS and + 2.6 +2.6 over hBehaveMAE) and level with BAMS at 5% (mean − 1.0 -1.0 ).
blocks.zh:
为了了解哪些成分很重要,第二次预先注册的测试会剥离代表。 它增加了测量
一次一组后,每一步对训练视频进行评分,然后在点数中选择最小的一步
完全设定。 规则选择了19个测量,除了姿势之外的一切. 在测试的视频中,
h 具有所有标签(+ 2.6 + 2.6 [+ 1.6 + 1.6,+ 3.8 + 3.8] ),并将BAMS与5%挂钩(− 1.4 - 1.4 [− 4.7 - 4.7,+ 4.1+4.1])。 完整的23是+0.8+0.8[+0.2+0.2,+1.5+1.5]的分数与所有标签都较好,所以它们仍然是方法. 对用两个重新训练的编码器
更多种子,19度测量版本保持其读数:在所有三个路段中,在两种标注之前(意为:
BAMS的比值为5%(平均值−1.0-1.0),BAMS的比值为7.2+7.2,BBAARE的比值为2.6+2.6。

blocks.en:
The other versions were read off the test videos, so they describe the method rather than test it: • Time windows matter more than the choice of measurements. The frame value with the 0.5 s and 2 s
windows alone scores 84.8 with all labels, 1.0 below the full set. The 8 s and 30 s windows alone score 69.6, and
frame values without any window 76.3. • No single group is essential with all labels. Dropping any one group costs at most 0.8 points (posture). With 5%
of labels, heading matters most (4.5 points), then distance (2.3) and nose (2.1). • One point per animal goes far. The 13 measurements that need only each mouse’s centre score 81.2 with
all labels, ahead of BAMS ( + 3.0 +3.0 [ + 0.8 +0.8 , + 5.1 +5.1 ]) and level with hBehaveMAE ( − 1.2 -1.2 [ − 2.8 -2.8 , + 0.1 +0.1 ]). With 5% of
labels they trail BAMS by 10.4. • Histograms matter with few labels. Without them the 5% score falls by 7.0 to 10.7 points, while with
all labels they are worth about one point.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en:
• Scope. The evidence is two mouse datasets, one fly dataset and one synthetic human dataset. CalMS21’s three
tasks come from one laboratory and setup, so Tasks 2 and 3 are not independent of Task 1. On flies the comparison is
with BAMS’s published score from a single submission, and the per-fly behavior tasks are not solved by a
representation that pools over flies. • Home ground. CalMS21’s poses come from MARS, and Task 1’s videos match the training and test sets of
MARS’s classifiers, which use hand-designed features. The benchmark paper [ 13 ] reports 79.3 for a
supervised 1D convolutional network, 82.9 when that network is given TREBA’s self-supervised features, and 86.4 for
the 2021 challenge winner, a semi-supervised model trained with the labels; our 85.8 uses a much smaller classifier. • Retrained opponents. On CalMS21 we retrained both encoders ourselves. They score above the numbers MICE
reports for them (hBehaveMAE 82.4 against 76.05, BAMS 78.3 against 74.98), but BAMS’s keypoint template was weak in
our hands, and its authors’ own mouse recipe, adapted to CalMS21’s seven keypoints (42 of its 66 input features remain), did worse still: 54.6 with all labels and 28.4 with 5%, below the 0.70 training-video floor, so the version fed our measurements stays the BAMS entry. • Few labels. With four labelled videos the comparison with BAMS is a tie, not a win. • MICE. It is the newest encoder and was not run, because its code was not released (its repository held only a placeholder README on 17 November 2026). Its reported CalMS21
score (83.3) comes from a setup that scores every method lower than ours, so it cannot be compared directly. • Frozen representations. We test frozen embeddings with a small classifier. Fine-tuned encoders, or
learned features at much larger scale with full supervision, may behave differently. • Uncertainty. Intervals cover the sampling of test videos. Training luck is covered by repeating each
encoder’s training with three seeds, not by the intervals.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Under one fair protocol, a training-free representation built from generic measurements and window statistics matches
or beats two published self-supervised behavior encoders on the standard mouse benchmarks, on a second species and
on a simulated human, where the learned encoder still wins on the shortest movements.
Most of the result comes from a few kinematic signals summarized over short windows; on mice and basketball, even raw
keypoints in the body’s own frame, summarized the same way, match or beat the encoders, while on flies the
measurements are needed. We suggest that new behavior
encoders report such a baseline next to their results, and we will release ours with its frozen fits, with the
conference version, so that it costs nothing to run.
